CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE R DEVDAS  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners are aggrieved of the impugned endorsement at Annexure-B issued by the 3rd respondent - Special Land Acquisition Officer, who has declined to accede to the claim of the petitioners, who are the owners of 1 acre 12 guntas of land in Sy.No.127 of Cheeluru Village,
Maralavadi Hobli, Kanakapura Taluk, Ramanagara District, for allotment of developed land in lieu of compensation or to pay compensation in terms of Section 29(2) of the KIADB Act.
2.

Learned counsel submits that the only ground on which the 3rd respondent has declined to accede to the request made by the petitioners is that the 3rd respondent has passed a general award and has deposited the compensation amount of Rs.12,56,388/- before the learned I Addl. District and Session Judge, Ramanagara.

entities.text: I Addl. District and Session Judge, Ramanagara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel however submits that this Court has the power to direct the 3rd respondent to accede to the NC: 2025:KHC:10092 request made by the petitioners.

Learned counsel has pointed to various such orders passed by this Court including the case in W.P.No.15877/2024 dated 28.06.2024.
3.

This Court finds that in umpteen number of cases, this Court has permitted the land losers to claim compensation as per the consent award upon establishing the fact that they are the owners of the property.
There is no reason why similar order should not be passed in the instant case also.
4. Hence, the following:
ORDER (
i) The writ petition is allowed.
(ii) The impugned general award at Annexure-N to the writ petition insofar as the land of the petitioners, which is the subject matter of the instant writ petition, is set aside.

(iii) The respondent/Special Land Acquisition Officer of the KIADB is directed to reconsider the request of the petitioners for award of compensation by way of an agreement under Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act NC: 2025:KHC:10092 and pass necessary orders within a period of three months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
(iv) The respondent/Special Land Acquisition Officer, KIADB, is at liberty to withdraw the amount that has been deposited by it pursuant to the general award before the jurisdictional Court.
